title: She saw more (Mekhilta, Shirata 3)
hook: a servant girl at the sea saw more than the prophet Ezekiel
tomorrow: "i will glorify Him." okay, but how, exactly?

segments.voice: That was a week of the unexpected: a palace with an owner, stones made one, a ladder, a thorn bush, a name made of deeds. And yesterday's line: the coal on the lips. Slow speech, still sent.
screen: `THE COAL ON THE LIPS.` → `A WEEK OF THE UNEXPECTED.`

segments.voice: At a magic show the adults watch the magician's hands. A kid near the front shouts: it's in his other sleeve! Sometimes the one nobody asked sees it first. When the sea split and Israel crossed, they sang: "This is my God, and I will glorify Him." The Mekhilta, a midrash on Exodus, stops on one small word: this.
screen: `IT'S IN HIS OTHER SLEEVE!` → `THIS IS MY GOD.` → `ONE SMALL WORD: THIS.`

segments.voice: You only say this about something you can point at. So the Mekhilta says: a servant girl at the sea saw what Isaiah and Ezekiel never saw. Ezekiel wrote, "the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God." Visions, through an opened sky. The girl at the sea didn't need a vision. She pointed. This. Notice who the midrash picked. Not a priest, not a scholar, not a prophet. A servant girl, someone nobody in Egypt asked for an opinion. Now the week, back as one picture. An owner who answers. Stones joined. A ladder you climb anyway. A thorn bush with fire in it. A name made of deeds. A coal on the lips. Each one is about who gets seen and who gets sent, and none of them are the obvious choices. The servant girl at the sea belongs on that list. She saw more.
screen: `THIS IS MY GOD: POINTING.` · `MORE THAN EZEKIEL SAW.` · `NOT A PROPHET. A SERVANT GIRL.` · `A WEEK OF THE UNEXPECTED.` · then, large: `SHE SAW MORE.`

segments.voice: Look out a window, or around the room, and find one thing you've walked past again and again without seeing. Look at it for the whole sit, as if no one had ever described it to you. Trust what your own eyes find there, and if a word comes, let it be a quiet this.
She saw more: the Mekhilta on the song at the sea. A servant girl, pointing, saw what prophets saw only in visions.
For the road: she saw more, with her own eyes. Two weeks of midrash, read.

screen: `DAY 1582 COUNTS.` → `READING MIDRASH · 15 OF 40.` → `TOMORROW: "I WILL GLORIFY HIM." OKAY, BUT HOW, EXACTLY?`
